answer: Escalating action-cost spiral: each repeated action from a linked identity doubles in fee, so the nth action costs base×2^(n-1). A farm of 20 identities each repeating one action 10 times pays not 20×base but ≈20×1023×base, since cost compounds per head, not pooled. The exponential becomes a punishing relic of the attacker's first move. Failure mode: dormant "echo accounts" that pause between bursts to reset the counter still decay idle stake, so waiting out the spiral drains the farm's treasury anyway.
